lines: Why is the sky blue, but sunsets are orange?
Sunlight looks white, but it's secretly every colour mixed together!
When it hits the air, blue bounces around the most, so it fills the whole sky.
At sunset, the light travels through way more air to reach you.
The blue gets bounced away, and only orange and red make it through!
And on Mars? It's the opposite. Mars has blue sunsets!
